scope: Six exact Draft carriers; four parallel review lanes; no target edits.

findings.title: Exact frontmatter encoding is missing
findings.issue: The packet requires stored values and selects frontmatter as their region, but gives no explicit YAML key/nesting encoding for the agreed property paths.
findings.counterexample: A writer can choose nested carrier_destination.file.name/path or flat/literal-dotted keys; readers choosing another form cannot round-trip the same Atom.
findings.basis: D478 operative Claim requires registered names/encodings and forbids inventing a field from the display path. D664 selects frontmatter and physical filename/location but does not register the concrete YAML keys.
findings.minimal_fix: Add explicit Delivery encoding for the already-agreed nested carrier_destination.file.name and carrier_destination.file.path keys, preserving the one-string declarations and existing physical-address rules.
findings.decision_note: The user already settled the property paths, meanings, mandatory values and frontmatter storage. The missing work is normative encoding of that decision.
findings.severity_limit: D657 categorical invalid/unadmitted wording is in Details. This review does not claim a proven operative-Claim contradiction or a candidate-specific Engine rejection.

findings.title: Promotion prerequisites omit mandatory-field population and validation
findings.issue: The Declarations require the hierarchy, while the Adoption paragraph defers population and migration without stating the prerequisites for activating the new required schema.
findings.counterexample: An existing Current Atom such as CA-R-2508@2 has no carrier_destination fields. Activating the new mandatory schema without population or an explicit transition boundary leaves it unable to satisfy the new contract.
findings.basis: This is a readiness condition for later adoption, not a contradiction in preparing Drafts and not an instruction to implement migration in this review.
findings.minimal_fix: State that promotion waits for the approved encoding plus population and validation of affected carriers, or an explicitly governed transition boundary. Keep the detailed process in the later Workflow/Engine work.

dispositions.disposition: No open choice: the user chose the calculated intended target; D480 already rejects silent address override.
Deferred operational process. Existing update and address-agreement invariants remain applicable; no new Draft blocker established.
